text:
Maya: hey team — quick thread to lock down next sprint's post-launch follow-on work. TL;DR: 3 customer-blocking bugs (two regressions, one edge-case crash), ~5 small enhancements, and a bunch of polish. Need triage rules + owners by EOD so we can cut the sprint.

Igor: I can take the regressions if we agree to a ctrl+hotfix flow. heads-up: infra oncall is thin next week, so any deploys need an oncall window. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Sofia: tagging customer priority: CustA (SLA impacted), CustB (usability), CustC (low). asking that we prioritise CustA bug and a quick UX tweak CustB asked for. link to support thread: https://support.redwood.ai/t/CUSTA-432

Liam: +1 to prioritising CustA. For enhancements: can we split 5 items into 2 MVPs? some are nice-to-have. prefer to scope smaller and ship.

Anika: estimate for the front-end regression is ~6 dev-hours + 2 for QA. I can own it if we freeze any new UI enhancements this sprint.

Maya: proposal: move CustA bug + regression hotfix into sprint backlog (must ship), pick 1 enhancement (highest ROI) as follow-on, rest go to grooming. Also propose triage rubric below — feedback?

Igor: rubric looks good, minor tweak: "High" should include severe perf regressions that affect >=5% of requests.

Sofia: agree on perf rule. also request that Customer Success gets an update template so we can communicate ETA consistently.

Maya: added a short template for CS: ```
ETA: <date/time> (business hours)
Owner: <name>
Impact: <customers affected/estimate>
Mitigation: <workaround if any>
Next update: <when>
```

SupportBot: new bug report created - ID BUG-2023-88. linked to thread above.

DevexBot: deploy scheduled for hotfix branch on 1718820000 (staging). please add approvals.

Liam: decision check: who owns the enhancement pick? Maya/pm should pick which one maps to roadmap. otherwise engineering will pick highest velocity item.

Maya: I'll pick the enhancement — leaning toward small perf cache change (big unit economics win). will post selection in #product by 3pm.

Anika: happy to take the regression and support the hotfix deploy window.

Igor: I'll coordinate oncall and rollout plan, + simple rollback playbook.

Sofia: I'll prepare the CS update and notify CustA.

Maya: summary: CustA bug + front-end regression = ship this sprint (owners: Sofia for CS comms, Anika for fix, Igor for rollout). Enhancement = perf cache change (Maya owner). Remaining items to grooming backlog. deadline: owners to add tracker issues & estimates by EOD. thanks! :rocket:
